style.common: High-quality anime key-art illustration for a fantasy trading card game. Landscape 4:3 composition, bold clean line art, cel shading with soft gradients, vivid saturated colors, dramatic lighting, large swirling painterly energy slashes and glowing particles in the background, strong focal subject in the center. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, card frames or borders.
style.unit: Character portrait, bust or three-quarter view, expressive large eyes, detailed hair and clothing.
style.spell: Pure magic effect scene with no people and no characters.
style.equipment: A single item shown as a hero object with no people and no characters, centered, with a magical swirl behind it.
